newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Sa Sa says Hong Kong IPO 531 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: HK's Sa Sa says Hong Kong IPO 531 times subscribed.

text.p: Cosmetics products retailer Sa Sa International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday its Hong Kong public offering of 59.04 million shares was about 531 times subscribed.
The company said it received applications for 31.32 billion shares compared with the 59.04 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong.
Another 6.56 million shares offered on a preferential basis to employees were fully allotted.
Sa Sa said the international placement portion of 262.40 million shares had been "very significantly oversubscribed".
The issue price has been set at HK$2.38 per share, it said.
Dealing in the shares is expected to begin on June 13.
Sa Sa offered a total 328 million new shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at an indicative price range of HK$2.00 to HK$2.38.
Sa Sa retails and wholesales a wide range of cosmetic products. It operates a chain of 11 retail outlets in Hong Kong and one in Taipei.
